projects.title: Low-Cost Sensor Network for Urban Air Quality Monitoring
projects.abstract: Deploys calibrated low-cost particulate and gas sensors across city wards and evaluates drift against reference stations over twelve months.

projects.title: Constructed Wetlands for Greywater Reuse in Apartment Complexes
projects.abstract: Pilot-scale wetlands treat apartment greywater for landscaping reuse, measuring nutrient removal and maintenance burden.

projects.title: Microplastic Load in Urban Lake Sediments
projects.abstract: Quantifies microplastic concentration and polymer types in sediment cores from three urban lakes to reconstruct accumulation trends.

projects.title: Satellite-Based Mapping of Urban Heat Islands
projects.abstract: Combines thermal satellite imagery with land cover data to map heat islands and test green-roof mitigation scenarios.

projects.title: Antimicrobial Peptide Library Screening Against Resistant Bacteria
projects.abstract: Builds and screens a designed peptide library for activity against drug-resistant clinical bacterial isolates with low host toxicity.

projects.title: CRISPR-Based Drought Tolerance in Finger Millet
projects.abstract: Edits stress-response genes in finger millet and measures yield stability under controlled water deficit.

projects.title: Rapid Paper-Based Diagnostic for Dengue Detection
projects.abstract: Develops a low-cost paper-based assay for early dengue antigen detection suitable for primary health centres.

projects.title: Probiotic Consortia for Poultry Gut Health
projects.abstract: Tests defined probiotic consortia as an alternative to antibiotic growth promoters in poultry feed trials.

projects.title: Attention Maps for Explainable Plant Disease Classification
projects.abstract: Trains vision models on leaf images and evaluates attention-based explanations against expert-marked lesion regions.

projects.title: Federated Learning for Hospital Records Without Data Sharing
projects.abstract: Evaluates federated training across simulated hospital silos and measures accuracy loss versus centralised training.

projects.title: Low-Resource Speech Recognition for Kannada Dialects
projects.abstract: Builds a small annotated corpus and fine-tunes speech models for regional Kannada dialects with limited labelled audio.

projects.title: Anomaly Detection in Smart Grid Meter Streams
projects.abstract: Compares lightweight streaming anomaly detectors for detecting theft and faults in smart meter data.

projects.title: Recycled Carbon Fibre Reinforced Thermoplastic Composites
projects.abstract: Characterises mechanical properties of thermoplastic composites made with recycled carbon fibre for automotive panels.

projects.title: Phase Change Materials for Building Thermal Storage
projects.abstract: Develops encapsulated phase change materials and tests passive cooling performance in wall panels.

projects.title: Graphene-Coated Electrodes for Low-Cost Biosensing
projects.abstract: Fabricates graphene-coated electrodes and compares sensitivity and stability for electrochemical biosensors.

projects.title: Self-Healing Concrete Using Bacterial Spores
projects.abstract: Embeds bacterial spores in concrete mixes and measures crack-closure rates and strength recovery.

projects.title: Perovskite Solar Cell Stability Under Humid Conditions
projects.abstract: Tests encapsulation strategies that extend perovskite cell lifetime under high humidity and thermal cycling.

projects.title: Second-Life Battery Packs for Rural Microgrids
projects.abstract: Assesses repurposed electric vehicle battery packs for village microgrids, covering degradation and safety monitoring.

projects.title: Biogas Yield Optimisation from Mixed Agricultural Waste
projects.abstract: Optimises feedstock ratios and pretreatment to raise biogas yield from crop residue and dairy waste.

projects.title: Small-Scale Wind Turbine Blade Design for Low Wind Speeds
projects.abstract: Designs and tests blade profiles for turbines operating at low average wind speeds typical of inland sites.

projects.title: Rhizobacterial Consortium for Water-Use Efficiency in Pulses
projects.abstract: Field trials of rhizobacterial consortia to improve water-use efficiency and yield in pulse crops under limited irrigation.

projects.title: Soil Moisture Forecasting for Smallholder Irrigation Scheduling
projects.abstract: Combines low-cost soil probes with weather forecasts to schedule irrigation for smallholder farms.

projects.title: Post-Harvest Loss Reduction in Tomato Supply Chains
projects.abstract: Maps loss points from farm to market and tests low-cost cold-chain interventions.

projects.title: Natural Pigment Extraction from Agricultural By-Products
projects.abstract: Extracts and stabilises natural pigments from fruit and vegetable by-products for food colouring uses.

projects.title: Wearable Sensing for Early Detection of Maternal Health Risk
projects.abstract: Evaluates wrist-worn sensors for flagging pregnancy-related risk signs and tests alert thresholds with clinicians.

projects.title: Digital Adherence Support for Tuberculosis Treatment
projects.abstract: Tests a reminder and tracking app to improve treatment adherence among community health clients.

projects.title: Low-Cost Prosthetic Hand Using 3D-Printed Components
projects.abstract: Designs a 3D-printed prosthetic hand with tendon actuation and evaluates grip performance and cost.

projects.title: Nutritional Screening Tool for School Children
projects.abstract: Validates a short screening tool for identifying malnutrition risk in school children across three districts.
